title: Single Phase vs 3-Phase Meter Pakistan 2026: 3-Phase Lagwane Ka Kharcha, Sanctioned Load Aur Tariff Rules
excerpt: Pakistan mein single phase se 3-phase meter conversion ka mukammal process, DISCO demand notice fee (K-Electric, LESCO, IESCO), load extension rules, aur sab se ahem: kya 3-phase par 200 units protected slab subsidy milti hai ya nahi?
author: Read Meter Tariff & Engineering Team
content:
## Single Phase Se 3-Phase Meter Par Shift Hona Kab Zaroori Hota Hai?

Pakistan mein garmiyon ke aate hi jab gharon mein 2 ya 3 inverter ACs, water motor, aur deep freezer aik sath chalte hain, to aksar single-phase meter par voltage drop, breaker tripping, ya main service wire jalne ke masail pesh aate hain.

Aksar sarfeen yeh sochte hain ke **3-phase meter lagwane se bijli ka bill kam aayega ya zyada?** Aur K-Electric ya WAPDA (LESCO, IESCO, FESCO) 3-phase connection ke liye kitni security fee aur demand notice charge karte hain?

Is tafseeli guide mein hum NEPRA regulations 2026 ke tehat Single Phase vs 3-Phase ke tamam technical, financial, aur tariff rules ka jaiza lenge.

---

## 1. Single Phase Aur 3-Phase Mein Bunyadi Farq (Technical Comparison)

| Feature | Single Phase Connection | 3-Phase Connection |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Voltage Supply** | 220V – 230V (1 Live + 1 Neutral) | 400V – 415V (3 Live + 1 Neutral) |
| **Sanctioned Load Limit** | 1 kW se 4 kW (Max 5 kW) | 5 kW se 15+ kW (Heavy Residential Load) |
| **Ideal Home Load** | 1 Inverter AC + Fridge + Lights/Fans | 2 ya 3+ ACs, Water Motor, Geyser, Solar Inverter |
| **Voltage Fluctuations** | Zyada (Peak hours mein dim lights) | Intehai Kam (Load 3 phases par balance hota hai) |
| **Wire Thickness** | 7/0.029 ya 7/0.036 copper wire | 7/0.044 ya 7/0.052 4-core armored cable |
| **Protected Slab Eligibility** | ✅ Milti hai (Agar <= 200 units hon) | ❌ NEPRA Rules: 3-Phase par protected slab nahi milta |

---

## 2. Sab Se Bara Shock: Kya 3-Phase Meter Par 200 Units Protected Slab Milta Hai?

Yeh Pakistan ke 90% sarfeen ke liye sab se ahem maloomat hai:

> **⚠️ NEPRA Tariff Notification Rule:**
> Pakistan mein **3-Phase Domestic (A-1 Residential) connections ko 'Protected Slab' (Rs 7.74 se Rs 14.95) ki category se mustasna (exempt) rakha gaya hai**. 3-phase meter par har soorat mein **Unprotected Tariffs** lagte hain, chahay aap mahana 150 units hi kyun na jalayein!

Agar aapka ghar chhota hai aur aapka bijli ka istemal pichle 6 maheeno se 200 units se kam hai, to **3-phase meter par convert hote hi aapka base unit rate taqreeban double ho jayega** (Rs 14/unit se seedha Rs 22 se Rs 34/unit + taxes)!

Is liye sirf us waqt 3-phase par switch karein jab:
1. Aapke ghar ka actual continuous connected load **5 kW se barh gaya ho**.
2. Aap **on-grid 3-phase solar system (5kW, 10kW)** lagwa rahe hon aur green net meter zaroori ho.
3. Single phase par voltage 160V tak gir jati ho aur AC start na hota ho.

---

## 3. 3-Phase Meter Lagwane Ka Mukammal Kharcha (2026 Demand Notice Rates)

Pakistan mein kisi bhi distribution company (K-Electric, LESCO, IESCO, MEPCO) se 3-phase meter lene ke liye darj zail ikhrajat aate hain:

### A. Official Demand Notice Charges (DISCO Fee):
- **Security Deposit (Refundable):** Rs 18,000 se Rs 25,000 (Sanctioned load ke hisab se, e.g. 5kW load).
- **Meter Cost (3-Phase Digital Smart Meter):** Rs 22,000 se Rs 28,000.
- **Service Line / Cable Charges:** Rs 10,000 se Rs 16,000 (Transformer se ghar ke faasle ke mutabiq).
- **Total Official Demand Notice:** Taqreeban **Rs 55,000 se Rs 70,000 PKR**.

### B. Internal Wiring & DB Box Modifications (Ghar Ka Kharcha):
- 4-Pole Main Circuit Breaker (63A): Rs 4,500 – Rs 6,500
- Phase Selector Changeover Switch: Rs 3,500 – Rs 5,000
- Electrician Labor & Phase Balancing: Rs 8,000 – Rs 12,000

---

## 4. Single Phase Par Load Balance Karne Ke 3 Tips (Bina 3-Phase Lagwaye)

Agar aap 3-phase ke bhari demand notice aur un-protected tariffs se bachna chahte hain, to mandarja zail smart tareeqay apnayein:

1. **Inverter AC Staggering:** 2 inverter ACs ko aik sath on na karein. Pehle ek AC chala kar kamra 26°C par cool kar lein, phir doosra AC on karein taake startup surge breaker trip na kare.
2. **Motor Timing:** Pani ki 1HP ya 1.5HP motor ko shaam ke peak hours (6 PM se 10 PM) mein hargiz na chalayein. Subah 8 baje se pehle motor chala kar tanki bhar lein.
3. **Read Meter App Se Daily Tracking:** Har 2 din baad apne meter ki reading hamare [Read Meter App](https://www.readmeter.online/) mein log karein taake aapko daily average units aur mahana slab ka pehle se pata chal sakay.

---

## Khulasa (Verdict)
Agar aapka continuous load 4 kW ke andar hai aur aap 200 units protected slab ke kareeb hain, to **Single-Phase meter par rehna hi sab se bari maali bachat hai**. Lekin agar 3 ACs, heavy solar net-metering, ya commercial activity hai, to 3-phase meter lagwana technical majboori ban jata hai.

faqs.question: Kya 3-phase meter lagwane se bijli ka bill kam aata hai?
faqs.answer: Nahi! Bill units (kWh) par banta hai, phases par nahi. 3-phase meter voltage stability deta hai lekin unit rate protected slab na milne ki wajah se zyada par sakta hai.

faqs.question: Single phase se 3-phase conversion mein kitna time lagta hai?
faqs.answer: Online application jama karwane aur Demand Notice pay karne ke baad K-Electric ya WAPDA aam tor par 15 se 25 working days ke andar naya meter install kar dete hain.

faqs.question: Solar net metering ke liye 3-phase meter zaroori hai?
faqs.answer: Jee haan, Pakistan mein NEPRA regulations ke tehat 5kW ya is se baray on-grid solar systems par net-metering ke liye 3-phase bidirectional green meter lazmi hai.
